children: Tamara Hughes Gustavson disclosed ownership of a 5.98% stake, or 21,470,284 Class A shares, in American Homes 4 Rent. She filed a new Schedule 13D on Sep. 11, 2026, after she and B. Wayne Hughes reported they no longer act as a group. The filing keeps her in compliance while confirming her ongoing role as a major investor.

Gustavson holds the shares for investment. She states the filing is “not being made as a result of any particular acquisition or disposition” and is required because she no longer files as part of a group.

She currently has “no plans or proposals” for corporate actions like mergers, asset sales, or board changes, though she may buy or sell shares over time. As a trustee of American Homes 4 Rent, she may from time to time bring ideas to the board.

Tamara Hughes Gustavson is an American investor and philanthropist with deep roots in real estate. She serves on the Board of Trustees of American Homes 4 Rent and invests through personal accounts and family trusts with a long-term focus. She is known for significant holdings tied to self‑storage and single‑family rental housing, including interests associated with Public Storage and American Homes 4 Rent.
